bias.en: Range · SAR flipped bullish, back under the 100-day
bias.zh: 区间震荡 · 抛物线 SAR 转为看多，跌回 100 日均线下方

read.en: SPCX fell 2.3% on Nov 11 to $139.75, trading $138.62–145.16. It is above the 5-day ($136.6) and 10-day ($137.5) and below the 100-day ($142.8) and 30-day ($149.0), all falling (no 200-day yet, 106 sessions). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 14, below zero, histogram nearly closed (a cross up is close); Parabolic SAR flipped bullish on Nov 11 ($120.39), and RSI is 46.8.
read.zh: SPCX 11月11日下跌 2.3%，收于 $139.75，盘中区间 $138.62–145.16。股价位于 5 日（$136.6）和 10 日均线（$137.5）上方，100 日（$142.8）和 30 日均线（$149.0）下方，均在下行（上市仅 106 个交易日，尚无 200 日均线）。MACD 自 10月14日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图接近收拢（临近上穿）；抛物线 SAR 于 11月11日转为看多（$120.39），RSI 为 46.8。

read.en: The $145.16 high stalled at the Nov 10 high, and the close lost the 100-day and the $140.66 Oct 15 low, now resistance. Resistance is $140.7–143.2 (Oct 15 low, 100-day, Nov 9 high), then $144.9–145.2 (Nov 10–11 highs) and $149–149.8 (30-day, Aug 17 high). Support is $136.6–138.6 (5 and 10-day, Nov 10–11 lows), then $134.3–135.4 and $130.2–131.9. A close above $143.2 would target $145; below $136.6, $134–135.
